stage: G-V1 V2b: two right ears + left slide-in flange, JLC PA12 wall rules
rear_panel_status: uniform 2.0mm plate, internal ribs, no snap latches
assembly_order: rear panel + PCB/display/battery/speaker + four PCB screws first; FRONT shell lowered from +Z (four ears stay outside the body and do not sweep the PCB); four M2 shell screws from REAR

pcb_screw.kind: M2.5x5 machine screw into original metal insert

shell_screw.kind: M2x6 self-tapping into PA12, two right-side ears with Ø5.0 bosses (JLC 1.5x wall)
shell_screw.status: nominal geometry only; PA12 thread strength, torque and repeated service unverified

ears.status: right pair only; left seam held by two slide-in flanges

rear_ribs.status: internal stiffeners, clear of PCB seats, battery, speaker and wire lanes

tf_opening: removed; TF card stays inside and is reached by opening the clamped rear cover
bat_pwr_leaf: straight rounded-rectangle leaf replaces the TF-clearing L shape
speaker_wire_entry: +Y edge (toward the battery; the photo's speaker bottom), not -Y
usb_opening: unchanged 13.2 x 7.3mm after user insertion test; no reduction
mic_note: V1 CAD front face has no hole; V1 print hole is post-print. V2b leaves the front solid; drill the V1 location or mark it.

left_flange.function: front-shell slide-in flange; rear face bears on rear-panel inner face at seam; right screws pull; no left screw

jlc_rules.source: 嘉立创3D打印设计规范 (jlc-3dp.cn/technicalColumnsDetails/27832.html) and JLC3DP design guideline
jlc_rules.printed_threads: min M6; self-tapping plastic screws use boss ≥1.5x pilot diameter
jlc_rules.v2b_response: lip 1.0mm + 0.3mm gap; right ear boss 5.0mm (pilot 1.7 -> 1.65mm wall); left flange 1.5mm; window 0.3/side; no 0.2mm window
